Container.Name: cloudclone
Container.Overview: Periodically mirrors Google Drive to your array (read-only, incremental via rclone). Web UI for Google sign-in, schedules (daily/weekly/monthly), manual runs and live progress. Supports multiple accounts.

Config.Name: Backup Folder
Config.Description: Single folder for everything. The app creates Data/ (backed-up files, one sub-folder per account) and Config/ (settings and Google tokens) inside it.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Optional. HTTPS address of this app via your reverse proxy, e.g. https://gdrive.example.com. Enables one-click Google sign-in (no copy/paste).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns backed-up files (99 = nobody)
